purpose: Compact memory of qualified Confluence of Minds distribution and outreach opportunities. Preserve history and avoid resurfacing the same opportunity unless materially changed.

entries.reason: Active listener-focused directory dedicated to binge-ready audio fiction, updated on 2026-09-18 and explicitly accepting completed shows. SILMEA has a completed 11-episode French SF audio season, Zone Aphotique, plus other full-cast fiction. Web search found no existing SILMEA or Zone Aphotique listing.
entries.draft: Créations SILMEA is a French audio-fiction project built as films without images. Its completed 11-episode SF season Zone Aphotique uses a full cast, original music and spatialised underwater sound; the feed also includes Crime sur la Croisette, created for the Festival de Cannes.

entries.reason: Current community-rated audio-drama directory with French-language filtering and free creator submissions. It requires at least 3 published episodes; Créations SILMEA has 50 episodes and fits its audio-drama/sound-design taxonomy. Web search found no existing SILMEA or Zone Aphotique listing.
entries.draft: Créations SILMEA is a French audio-drama feed with 50 episodes, full-cast fiction and immersive sound design, including the completed 11-episode SF series Zone Aphotique and Crime sur la Croisette, the Festival de Cannes audio fiction.

entries.reason: Active European podcasting newsletter and professional community. The site currently reports 2,200+ newsletter subscribers and a 500+ member Eurosounds group, explicitly inviting members to promote work, ask for help and seek collaborators. Strong European/French audio-fiction fit but less direct than a dedicated discovery directory.
entries.draft: I am resurfacing a French audio-fiction project called SILMEA, built around the idea of films without images: full casts, music, sound design and spatial audio. I would be interested in comparing notes with European fiction-audio creators and curators working on immersive narrative formats.
